description: Full profile of one surf town: description, season, water temperature, wave types, levels and curated surf spots (each with its type, level, the way its coast faces in degrees (facing), its best tide where known (tide, e.g. "low to mid, rising", with tideSources), reviewed photos of surf at that break when there are any (photo: the first; photos: up to 5, someone surfing first, each with the author and licence its credit names; most are freely licensed, but those with source "owned" are Swell Cabin's own, bought (Swell Cabin uses them on its site and its own social posts, credited "Swell Cabin"): they are licensed for showing only with a link to the town page, not for reuse elsewhere; the town's own photo, photo, may be one too), and reviewed YouTube surf clips filmed there: clips[].url). `stories` are a few true things worth telling about the town, each fact-checked against the pages in its `sources`: its surf history (kind history, with the year), a fact about the place or its waves (fact) and a place worth a stop (place); they answer what a town is known for, and each story's own page on Swell Cabin (`url`: /town/<slug>/story/<id>) carries the whole story, the outside pages being its sources. `dataQuality` says how far to trust the town's data (trust 0–100 and level high/medium/low, when it was last checked against sources, how many spots are verified, open audit warnings): low trust, or data never checked, means its figures may be wrong. `surfByMonth` gives, for each month, how often the surf was good there, measured over the last three years (goodDays, greatDays: % of days rated Good or better / Great or better at the best spot; seaTempC: the mean sea temperature measured by satellite, NASA JPL MUR SST; waveHeightM; rainMm: the mean rain of the month in town) and drySeason (the measured dry months, or all/none), with its source: the measured answer to "when should I go" (the waves, and the weather for the trip), not a forecast. `seasons` answers "is it worth going outside the season, and what should I expect": season (the best months with their measured good/great days, wave height, sea and rain), allYear, and rest: the other months in runs (Biarritz: summer and winter), each compared with the season (waves smaller/bigger/same, water warmer/colder, rain wetter/drier, surf worth/fewer/rare), forLearners (smaller waves at a town with beginner spots), nearlyAsGood (a month in the run nearly as good as the season: a shoulder month) and inSeasonNearby (towns within 300 km whose own season it is then, e.g. Keramas on Bali's east coast when the Bukit's season is over). `links.tides`, where the town has a tide gauge, is its tide page on Swell Cabin: the tide chart and tide times (highs and lows) for the coming days, the gauge, and each spot's best tide; surf_forecast has the tides in its days.
name: get_town
title: Get a surf town
